description: TfL publishes London bus shelters as point features. Shelters are physical passenger facilities and are distinct from the separately published bus-stop dataset. The metadata supplies the service and layer identity, while the layer schema describes its attributes. It does not establish shelter condition, capacity or a complete maintenance history. These locations can be used as passenger-facility inputs alongside stop and route data. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
